chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: what you can do with it, and how to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: C++ is one of the most popular

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: programming languages in the world, and

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: is the language of choice for building

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: games, device drivers, web browsers,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: servers, operating systems, and so on.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: That's why it's used by large companies

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: version at this time is version 20. The

chunks.text: next version is coming out next year.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, there are people like our famous

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: superstar developer, John Smith, who

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: think that C++ is no longer relevant

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: or C#. That is not true. C++ is still

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: one of the fastest and most efficient

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: languages available. So, if you you to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: build an application that needs to be

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: fast and use memory efficiently, C++ is

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: a great choice. This is an advantage

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: that it has over languages like C# and

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Java.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: C++ is also one of the first languages

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: often taught to computer science or

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: software engineering students because it

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: has influenced many programming

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: languages like C#, Java, JavaScript,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: TypeScript, Dart, and so on. So, if

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you're looking for a job as a software

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: engineer, learning C++ is a great

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: investment and opens a lot of doors for

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you. According to indeed.com, the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: average salary of a C++ programmer in

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the US is just over $170,000

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: a year.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, to master C++, there are two things

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you need to learn.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: One is the C++ language itself, meaning

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the syntax or the grammar of this

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: language. The second thing you need to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: learn is the C++ standard library or

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: STL, which is a collection of

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: pre-written C++ code that provides

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: functionality that is required by many

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: applications. Examples are data

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: structures like lists and maps and

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: algorithms for searching and sorting

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: data. These functions are required in

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: almost every application. So, instead of

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: us creating all this functionality from

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: scratch every single time, we can reuse

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: some of the C++ code in this library to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: quickly build applications. In this

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: course, we'll explore major

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: functionalities in the standard library,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: but the standard library is huge. So,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: we'll only scratch the surface. If you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: want to learn more, there are books

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: specifically written on this topic. Now,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: a lot of people find C++ a bit extensive

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and intimidating, but in reality, you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: don't need to learn all of C++ to be

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: able to write substantial programs. For

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the same reason, you don't need to learn

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: every feature your TV provides just to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: use and enjoy it. So, in this course,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: we're going to explore C++ step by step,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and as we go, I'm going to show you how

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you can write some really cool programs

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: as you're learning C++. Plus, I'm going

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you better understand and remember the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: concepts. Then you will see that C++ is

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: not really that difficult. So, if you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you'll be able to write C++ code with

chunks.title: YouTube Video

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: everything works.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: All right. Let's start with a metaphor.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Think of your TV. Your TV has several

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: functions. It has functions for changing

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the channel, controlling the volume, and

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: so on. By the same token, a C++ program

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: consists of tens or hundreds or

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: thousands of functions, each serving a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: purpose. Now, we have a special function

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: here called main, which is the entry

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: point to our program. This is like the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: power button of a TV, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, note that C++ is a case-sensitive

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: language, so it's sensitive to lowercase

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and uppercase letters. So, make sure to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: type this exactly as I show you. So, if

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: you type a capital M here, this is going

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: to have a different meaning, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: we're defining a function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, before the function name, we should

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: specify the type of value it's going to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: return.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: This main function should return a value

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: of type int, which is short for integer,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and that represents a whole number like

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: 1 2 3 4 and so on.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, when we run our program, the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: operating system, like Windows or macOS,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: is going to execute this function and

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the value that this function returns

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: tells the operating system if our

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: program terminated successfully or not,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, here we have int followed by white

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: space and then the name of the function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, white spaces in C++ are often

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: ignored, so whether we have one or 10

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: spaces, it doesn't really matter. But,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: in terms of formatting our code, it's

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: better to go with one space because we

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: want to format this code professionally,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: just like how we write an article. We

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: want to format our code just like a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: published article, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, after the function name, we type a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: pair of parentheses,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and inside the parentheses, we can

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: specify the parameters of this function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, a function can have zero or more

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: parameters. For now, let's not worry

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: about them. We'll talk about them later.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Then, we type a space again for proper

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: formatting, followed by a pair of

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: braces.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, inside the braces,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: we can type the code for this function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, whatever we type here will be

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: executed when the operating system

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: executes our main function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, once again, in terms of formatting,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: there are two schools of thought for

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: adding the braces. Some people like to

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: add the left brace on the same line as

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: The other people like to put the left

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: brace on a new line. There's really no

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: right or wrong here. So, whatever you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: prefer, just stick to that and make sure

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: your code is consistent. In this course,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: I'm going to put the left brace on the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: same line where we define a function,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, in this function, we want to write

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: code to print something on the screen.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: And for that, we're going to use the C++

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: standard library. So, earlier I told you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: that the standard library provides a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: bunch of capabilities that we need in

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: almost every application. So, on the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: top,

chunks.text: we type hashtag include,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and in angle brackets, we specify the

chunks.text: name of one of the files in the standard

chunks.text: library. That is IO stream, which is

chunks.text: short for input output stream. In this

chunks.text: file, we have capabilities for printing

chunks.text: something on the screen or getting input

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: supermarket has different sections, the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: standard library also has different

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: files, each serving a purpose.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, as we go through the course, you

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: will learn about the other files in the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: standard library, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, back to our main function.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, here we type STD, that is short for

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: standard library. And this is like a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: bucket or a container for the features

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: that are currently available to us. So,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: the features we have imported on the

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: top, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, if we type double colons, we can see

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: all these features. Now, there are a ton

chunks.text: of features here. Don't worry about any

chunks.text: use C out. That is short for character

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: using this object, we can output one or

chunks.text: angle brackets, another space,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: and then in double quotes, we type the

chunks.text: hello world, okay?

chunks.text: And then we terminate this line using a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: semicolon, just like how we terminate

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: our sentences with a period.

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: So, in C++, this line is called a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: statement because it tells the operating

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: system what to do. So, whenever we type

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: a statement, we should terminate it with

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: a semicolon, okay?

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: Now, finally,

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: we return the value of zero, and once

chunks.text: again, we need to terminate this with a

chunks.title: YouTube Video
chunks.text: semicolon. But, why zero? Well, zero
